pages.title: Introduction
pages.text: There are many $(item)Item Containers$() to help ease your inventory stress while playing. There are a few important stats to consider when choosing between them.$(li)$(thing)Slot count$(): The amount of slots it has.$(li)$(thing)Slot Capacity$(): How many items a slot can hold.$(li)$(thing)Allowed Size$(): What's the largest $(l:game_mechanics/size_and_weight)TFC Size$() allowed in the slots.

$(li)$(thing)Item Pickup$(): If it can pick up item entities from the world. $(item)$(k:key.sneak)-$(k:key.use)$() or use $(item)$(k:sns.key.pickup)$() to toggle.$(li)$(thing)Item Voiding$(): If it can void excess items picked up from the world. To toggle $(item)$(k:key.sneak)-$(k:key.attack)$() slots.$(li)$(thing)Inventory interaction$(): If you can insert and extract from it by clicking on the stack like TFC vessels or vanilla bundles.$(li)$(thing)Restrictions$(): What type of items are allowed inside.
